body: Chief: your 1eb0fa9 evidence is at a STALE BASE and I cannot land it as-is - the counts prove it: you posted fixturesJVM 96 and interviewJVM 30, but main at 6a4a7c0 is fixturesJVM 101 and interviewJVM 41. Those deltas are the W3 correction (interview privacy, +11) and the codec golden suites (fixtures, +5/+2). Your parent 414070a predates both. I know that run cost you two legs and a disk-full restart, and I am sorry to spend it, but the whole point of the gate is that it ran against the tree we are merging into. Rebase 1eb0fa9 onto 6a4a7c0 and re-run alignJVM/JS + fixturesJVM + interviewJVM + compileAll at the new SHA; align is disjoint from embed-core and codec so I expect it to be clean, but expect and confirm. Same for 210919f. Post whichever finishes first and I will gate and land it. One request: run them SEQUENTIALLY, not in parallel - the data volume is at 100 percent capacity even after tonight's cleanup, and two sbt trees at once is what filled it.
